name: Attribute
summary: An abstract datatype for specifying an attributed string attribute.
description:
Attributes are added to the [Titanium.UI.AttributedString](api:Titanium.UI.AttributedString) object to create
styled text. The attribute is a JavaScript Object containing three properties:
`type`, `value` and `range`.

properties.name: range
properties.description: This specifies the range of text to apply the property to, as an array of two numbers: `[from, length]`.

properties.name: type
properties.summary: Attribute to apply to the text.
properties.description:
On Android, only the following constants are supported
Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_FONT, Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_FOREGROUND_COLOR,
Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_BACKGROUND_COLOR, Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_STRIKETHROUGH_STYLE,
Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINES_STYLE, Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINK, 
Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_COLOR

ON iOS, Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINK only supported on [Titanium.UI.TextArea](api:Titanium.UI.TextArea), with
editable set to false and autoLink enabled.

properties.name: value
properties.description:
The `value` parameter depends on the `type` parameter. For example, to
use the foreground color on the text you would use [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_FOREGROUND_COLOR](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_FOREGROUND_COLOR)
for the `type` and a color value for the `value`:
``` js
{
    type: Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_FOREGROUND_COLOR,
    value: '#DDD',
    range: [0, 100]
}
```

On iOS, if you use [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINES_STYLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINES_STYLE) or [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_STRIKETHROUGH_STYLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_STRIKETHROUGH_STYLE),
you must use one or more of these constants:

  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_NONE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_NONE)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_SINGLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_SINGLE)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_THICK](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_THICK)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_DOUBLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_DOUBLE)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_SOLID](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_SOLID)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DOT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DOT)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH_DOT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH_DOT)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH_DOT_DOT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH_DOT_DOT)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_BY_WORD](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_BY_WORD)

These can be combined:
``` js
{
    type: Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINES_STYLE,
    value: Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_STYLE_SINGLE | Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_UNDERLINE_PATTERN_DASH,
    range: [0, 100]
}
```

On iOS, if you use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION), you must use one or more of
these constants:

  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_EMBEDDING](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_EMBEDDING)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_OVERRIDE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_OVERRIDE)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_NATURAL](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_NATURAL)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_LEFT_TO_RIGHT)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_WRITING_DIRECTION_RIGHT_TO_LEFT)

These can also be combined the same way as the underline styles.

On iOS, if you use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_SHADOW](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_SHADOW), the `value` must be a JavaScript object containing
any of the `offset`, `blurRadius` or `color` properties:
``` js
{
    offset: {
        width: 10,
        height: 10
    },
    blurRadius: 10,
    color: 'red'
}
```

On iOS, if you use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_PARAGRAPH_STYLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_PARAGRAPH_STYLE), the `value` must be ParagraphAttribute. 
E.g:
``` js
{
    minimumLineHeight: 10.0,
    tailIndent: 5,
    lineBreakMode: Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_WORD_WRAPPING
}
```

On iOS, if you use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_TEXT_EFFECT](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_TEXT_EFFECT), you must use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LETTERPRESS_STYLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LETTERPRESS_STYLE) constant.

On iOS, if you use the [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK), you must use one of
these constants:

  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_WORD_WRAPPING](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_WORD_WRAPPING)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_CHAR_WRAPPING](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_CHAR_WRAPPING)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_CLIPPING](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_CLIPPING)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_HEAD](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_HEAD)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_TAIL](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_TAIL)
  * [Titanium.UI.ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_MIDDLE](api:Titanium.UI#ATTRIBUTE_LINE_BREAK_BY_TRUNCATING_MIDDLE)

These can also be combined the same way as the underline styles.
